title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-08-01 18:12:25 最新章节：第316章 大白不怕因果吗
content_zh:
【脑子冰冻处】
【冰一冰，更保鲜】
炎炎八月，西开市。
空气燥热，连风都带着温度。
城西的废弃工业区，锈迹斑斑的钢筋水泥趴在地上。
“刺啦——”
一声金属刮擦声。
四道人影围着一个浑身漆黑、动作极快的小妖，打得难解难分。
剑光、符箓、法术的光芒交织，却总被那小妖躲过。
而在不远处一座废弃水塔的顶端，画风截然不同。
陈邪端着一桶热气腾腾的红烧牛肉面，另一只手拿着塑料叉子，嗦得正香。
他一边吃，一边看着下方的战斗。
“啧啧，这走位，这配合，葫芦娃救爷爷，一个一个送啊。”
他脚边，一只体型硕大的白鹅，正伸长了脖子，看着他。
“给鹅爷留口汤，别他妈独吞了！”大白鹅口吐人言，声音是个粗犷的公鸭嗓。
陈邪头也不抬，又嗦了一大口面。
“急什么，面还没吃完呢。”
“要是听鹅爷的，第一天就直接去市中心广场，你表演个倒立拉屎，不出十分钟，749局长都得亲自来接你！”大白鹅扑腾了一下翅膀，很不耐烦。
陈邪的脸黑了。
十天了！

整整十天了！
他来到这西开市，每天顶着大太阳，跟个无业游民似的四处乱逛，就为了找传说中的749局。
结果呢？
毛都没找到一根。
全身上下就剩下二十块两毛钱，这桶泡面还是他最后的晚餐。
要不是今天运气好，撞见这伙人处理“特殊事件”，他明天就得去天桥底下跟人抢地盘了。
一想到这事，陈邪就想把他那三个不靠谱的师傅从十万大山里刨出来。
炼鬼老祖、蛊毒鬼医、阴行扎纸婆。
名头一个比一个响，一个比一个邪性。
三个老怪物把他养大，教他的东西也是五花八门，突出一个高效实用。
临下山前，三个老怪物语重心长地告诉他：“阿邪啊，咱们这种人，在外面容易被那些名门正派喊打喊杀。所以，要想活得滋润，邪修的尽头就是考编上岸。”
“去做人上人，去拿铁饭碗！”
“记住，不管是人是鬼，不听话就物理毁灭。”
陈邪当时就懵了。
合着我学了一身炼鬼、养蛊、扎纸人的本事，就是为了去当个公务员？
可师命难违。
三个老不死的就给了他一封皱巴巴的信，还有一个名字——江听洲。
然后就把他一脚踹出了十万大山。
更要命的是，三个老怪物还再三告诫他，在正式加入749之前，千万别搞事。
content_en:
【Brain Freeze】
[ice, keep fresher]
In the hot August, the market opens in the west.
The air is hot and dry, and even the wind carries the temperature.
In the abandoned industrial area in the west of the city, rusty steel and concrete lie on the ground.
"Stab-"
There was a scraping sound of metal.
Four figures surrounded a little demon who was covered in darkness and moved very fast, and they were fighting hard to separate him.
The light of swords, talismans, and spells intertwined, but the little demon always dodged it.
On the top of an abandoned water tower not far away, the painting style is completely different.
Chen Xie was holding a bucket of steaming braised beef noodles and a plastic fork in his other hand, which was very fragrant.
As he ate, he watched the battle below.
"Tsk, tsk, this movement, this coordination, the calabash babies save grandpa, send them off one by one."
At his feet, a huge white goose stretched its neck and looked at him.
"Save the soup for Mr. Goose, don't swallow it all alone!" The big white goose spoke human words in a rough male duck voice.
Chen Xie didn't even raise his head and took another mouthful of noodles.
"What's the rush? I haven't finished eating the noodles yet."
"If you listen to Mr. Goose, go directly to the city center square on the first day. You perform a handstand and shit. In less than ten minutes, the director of 749 will have to pick you up in person!" The big white goose flapped its wings and became very impatient.
Chen Xie's face turned dark.
Ten days!
It’s been ten days!
He came to Xikai Market and wandered around like a vagrant under the bright sun every day, just to find the legendary 749 game.
The result?
Not a single hair was found.
With only twenty yuan and two cents left in his body, this bucket of instant noodles was his last supper.
If he hadn't been lucky today and bumped into this group of people dealing with a "special incident", he would have had to fight for territory under the overpass tomorrow.
When he thought about this, Chen Xie wanted to dig out his three unreliable masters from the mountain.
The ancestor of ghost refining, the ghost doctor who poisons poison, and the yin practitioner Zhizhi Po.
Each name is louder than the last, and each one is more evil than the last.
Three old monsters raised him and taught him a variety of things, one of which was efficient and practical.
Before going down the mountain, the three old monsters told him earnestly: "Ah Xie, people like us are easily beaten and killed by the decent people outside. Therefore, if you want to live a prosperous life, the end of the evil cultivator is to take the exam and get ashore."
"Be a master, and get a rice bowl!"
"Remember, whether it's a human or a ghost, if you don't obey, you will be physically destroyed."
Chen Xie was confused at that time.
I learned the skills of refining ghosts, raising voodoos, and making paper figurines, just to become a civil servant?
But it’s hard to disobey the teacher’s orders.
The three old immortals gave him a crumpled letter and a name - Jiang Tingzhou.
Then he kicked him out of the Hundred Thousand Mountains.
What's even worse is that the three old monsters repeatedly warned him not to cause trouble before officially joining 749.
